message:
The other day, I found myself rummaging through my closet, looking for the perfect pair of shoes for a family gathering. I stumbled upon our old go-bags, and it hit me—those bags haven’t been touched in ages. I opened one and was greeted by a mix of expired snacks and a half-eaten granola bar. Apparently, our preparedness plan had gone a bit stale, just like those snacks! 

It made me chuckle, but it also reminded me how easy it is to let things slide. I think it’s a good idea to take a little time now and then to refresh our plans and supplies. After all, staying ready doesn’t have to be serious business; sometimes, it’s just about a good laugh at our own expense. Have you checked your go-bag lately?
